thread:
tara: Quick sync on postmortem follow-ups for last night's KV latency spike. Need final owners for: 1) statuspage language, 2) short customer summary, 3) RCA sharing policy/template, 4) recurrence analysis. Prefer one owner per item so CS has a single POC.

ben: I can take statuspage + short customer blurb. Will draft two variants: consumer-friendly and enterprise-friendly. Posting by EOD today.

kai: I will own the RCA sharing policy. Proposal: default public summary within 48h, full sanitized RCA within 7 days, logs only shared to accounts who opt in via a consent flow. I'll sketch a template and consent checkbox.

helen: I'll maintain the action tracker and create JIRA tasks. Please add ticket IDs when you claim work. Also tagging sam for the KV mitigation ETA - we need that to include in the customer note.

sam: KV mitigation patch in progress, currently in perf tests. Tentative merge in 10 days. As an interim, we can add the mitigation text to the statuspage: "We applied temporary routing changes and autoscaling to reduce customer impact." Non-technical wording.

tara: Good. Ben — keep the statuscopy short. Kai — ensure the policy includes redaction rules and a one-page appendix describing what "sanitized logs" means. Helen — create the tracker doc and set reminder for 72h.

ops-bot: Created tickets: INC-9801 (statuspage + customer blurb) -> ben, due 2025-11-25; INC-9802 (RCA sharing policy + consent) -> kai, due 2025-11-23; INC-9803 (KV mitigation patch) -> sam, due 2025-12-05 (blocked: perf tests); INC-9804 (recurrence trend analysis) -> tara, due 2025-11-30.

ben: Draft posted to tracker: "We experienced intermittent write latency affecting a small number of customers. We implemented mitigations to reduce impact and are investigating the root cause. A detailed report will be posted within 7 days." Suggest we use "a small number of customers" per CS guidance.

kai: Adding redaction appendix now: remove customer IDs, exact timestamps linked to customers, IPs; keep anonymized timelines and aggregated metrics. Consent language: "I authorize Redwood to share sanitized logs for troubleshooting."

helen: Tracker updated with ticket links and owners. I've set a follow-up ping at 48h and added a CS contact row. If any owner misses their ETA, ops will post the interim summary and link to the statuspage.

tara: One more check: for enterprise accounts with special SLAs, route communications through Legal/AM and flag in the tracker. Kai/Ben, add a note for that.

sam: Noted. I'll also snapshot perf graphs and add a brief ETA note to the tracker so CS can give customers a clearer timeline.

ben: Will coordinate with Legal for enterprise phrasing. If legal needs more time, we'll publish the consumer copy and hold enterprise phrasing internally.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: ping thread in 48 hours if any tickets still open.

tara: Thanks everyone. Keep updates short in this thread so CS can follow. I'll close this sync after the 48h reminder and move discussion items to the tracker doc.

[end of thread]
